label: preparing
what: A community hospitality gathering/feast in the great hall at 18:00 on day 1, with lanterns and 200 fresh loaves; the occasion itself is being kept secret until the programme is announced. Builder and innkeeper coordinate; baker supplies the loaves, freight is involved in communicating/catering, and neighbour helped spread the invitation. Secretary knowingly facilitates and reports the plan, but is not clearly an organizer of the preparation itself. Mayor was invited and informed, so it is no longer undisclosed to the mayor by day 1; it was initially organized without telling him.
